# The A000 system library: one line per program

*README.MD file mostly generated by Anthropic's Claude AI because Thomas Dzubin hates documenting code.  LOL*

The HP 2000 Access system on the SD card holds 1054 contributed-library programs in
the system library (account A000, all UNRESTRICTED). List them on the terminal with
`LIBRARY`, load one with `GET-$name`, then `LIST` or `RUN`.

The descriptions below were taken from each program's own text: the header comment
(`NAME: description`), the first explanatory REM lines, or the first title or prompt it
prints. Programs that belong to a package (IDA, COFTAB, FINDIT, COBOL, the GPAC grade
programs and so on) say which package and which part. A `?` means no usable description
was found in the program. Treat the lines as a guide, not as HP documentation: the printed
descriptions are in `docs/manuals/5952-4369_Index_To_HP_2000_Series_Contributed_Library_Jul74.pdf`
(the 1974 index) and in the contributed library documentation volumes (`docs/manuals/36000-9100*`). Descriptions for the CTC, CWF and utility programs were filled in from those volumes.

2 programs have a `?`.
